memo_section_1_verbatim:
## 1. Hypotheses with sealed predictions

Write these into the prereg verbatim before any capture is opened. Bars are evaluated per (model, family) cell with n ≥ 8 items; smaller cells are reported, not judged.

### (a) Carrier layer as a fraction of depth

Two rules fit the three measured points (L20/28 = 0.71, L22/28 = 0.79, L23/36 = 0.64) about equally badly, and they disagree only on 36-layer models. Rule A1, a fixed fraction: the carrier layer is 0.72 ± 0.07 of depth. Rule A2, a fixed tail: the carrier is at L − (7 ± 2). Sealed predictions, carrier = modal (layer, kv) of the causal argmax cell over correct two-hop items (§3 defines the rule):

| Model | Layers | A1 fraction | A2 tail | My pick |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen3-0.6B-Base | 28 | L18–L22 | L19–L23 | L19–L22 |
| Qwen3-1.7B-Base | 28 | L20 (measured) | — | — |
| Qwen3-4B-Base | 36 | L23–L28 | L27–L31 | L24–L27 |
| Qwen2.5-0.5B | 24 | L16–L19 | L15–L19 | L16–L18 |
| Qwen2.5-1.5B | 28 | L22 (measured) | — | — |
| Qwen2.5-3B | 36 | L23–L28 | L27–L31 | L25–L28 |

I pick A1 (asserted, on the addition point L23/36 and the "upstream enrichment stops at a fraction of depth" reading). A1 wins if both 36-layer carriers are at or below L28; A2 wins if both are at or above L29. Within one model the carrier (layer, kv) mode covers ≥ 0.80 of correct two-hop items (measured 1.0 on 1.7B; the bar is lower because Qwen2.5-1.5B already shows a two-cell spread L22 KV1 / L23 KV0).

Second, sealed and cheap: the write window stays short. The single-cell causal strip at the carrier row (|dM| > 2 spacings) spans ≤ 5 layers on ≥ 0.70 of items in every model (measured 1.7B: L17–L21 on 45/64).

### (b) Hop budget: how many latent hops each size resolves, and whether readable errors predict the collapse

The model (derived, parameters asserted): let L_c be the carrier layer, L_1 the layer at which the first upstream hop's result (the entity's country for d2, the person for d3-per, the creator for d4) first appears in the carrier row's values, and k the layers one further upstream hop costs. The chain fits when L_1 + (hops − 1)·k ≤ L_c. On 1.7B, L_c = 20 and the two-hop country appears at median L7 in the descriptor row's other cells (measured, content strip), so d2 fits with 13 layers spare, d3 fits if k ≤ 13, and d4 fails when 2k > 13, i.e. k ≥ 7. Taking k ≈ 6 ± 1 layers per upstream hop at 28 layers (asserted so that d3 is marginal and d4 collapses, which is what was measured: 0.86 and 0.41) and scaling k with depth at the same fraction (k/L ≈ 0.21):

| Model | L_c (pick) | k | Predicted d2 | Predicted d3 (lm+per pooled) | Predicted d4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen3-0.6B-Base | L20 | 6 | 0.70–0.90 | 0.40–0.65 | ≤ 0.25 |
| Qwen3-1.7B-Base | L20 | 6 | 1.00 (measured) | 0.88 (measured) | 0.41 (measured) |
| Qwen3-4B-Base | L26 | 7–8 | ≥ 0.95 | ≥ 0.90 | 0.60–0.80 |
| Qwen2.5-0.5B | L17 | 5 | 0.60–0.85 | 0.30–0.60 | ≤ 0.20 |
| Qwen2.5-1.5B | L22 | 6 | 0.90–1.00 | 0.70–0.90 | 0.30–0.50 |
| Qwen2.5-3B | L26 | 7–8 | ≥ 0.90 | ≥ 0.80 | 0.50–0.75 |

The mechanistic prediction that makes this more than a scaling curve, and that is computable from the 1c captures for 1.7B today with no GPU (K and V at every row and layer are saved): define L_first(country) per item as the first layer at which any KV cell at the carrier row names the true country best-of-countries. Prediction B1: L_first is monotone in upstream hop count, median L_first(d2) < L_first(d3) < L_first(d4 correct), each step by ≥ 2 layers. Prediction B2 ("too late"): on wrong d3/d4 items L_first is either absent by L_c or later than correct items by ≥ 3 layers at the median; the slack L_c − L_first separates correct from wrong items within d3+d4 at AUC ≥ 0.75. Prediction B3 (repair): back-patching the carrier row's residual from L_c + 4 into L_c − 4 (one stepped `Run.set` at `t<r>.L<L_c−4>.h`, as TP1's per-row ablations) repairs ≥ 0.30 of wrong d4 items whose country appears late, against ≤ 0.10 of wrong items whose country never appears (the latter are recall failures, not budget failures). Prediction B4 (readable errors predict the collapse): in every (model, family) cell with accuracy < 0.5, the share of wrong items whose carrier names a wrong country or ranks the true one > 3 is ≥ 0.60, and across all (model, family) cells Spearman(readable-error share, 1 − accuracy) ≥ 0.5. Prediction B5 (scale moves recall, not composition; asserted from the literature prior): the gain from 1.7B to 4B on d4 comes with L_first(d4) moving earlier by ≥ 3 layers relative to L_c, not with the hop-2 ladder changing.

Hop 3 in the cell (the open unknown): the test is downstream necessity, not another readout. Mean-ablate the answer row's MLP writes at the layers where the language first appears (1.7B: L20–L22, measured) and compare the language-answer families with the capital-answer families. Prediction B6: the language margin drops by ≥ 2× the capital margin's drop (hop 3 is made downstream of the cell). If the drops are equal, the cell already carries the language and the readout's 75/132 is content, not projection leakage. The chance level for the projected-out language readout must be reported: shuffle the item's country across items, project out the shuffled country direction, score the language; the 75/132 counts only above that.

### (c) Does the hop-2 direct/MLP split shift with size

Prediction: the MLP share tracks the layers after the carrier, the tail T = L − L_c. Measured 1.7B: T = 8, MLP 0.55 (IQR 0.48–0.66). Sealed: Qwen3-4B (T ≈ 10) MLP 0.60–0.75; Qwen2.5-3B (T ≈ 10) 0.55–0.75; Qwen3-0.6B (T ≈ 8) 0.45–0.65; Qwen2.5-0.5B (T ≈ 7) 0.40–0.60; Qwen2.5-1.5B (T = 6) 0.35–0.55. The re-read term stays within ±0.10 everywhere. Report the split as median share with IQR over the donor arm and, per the R4 lesson, in dose units as well: run the donor transplant at α = 0.5 and 1.0 and report the MLP share at matched dose; a split that moves by more than 0.15 between doses is a threshold, not a share. The audit's point stands: this is accounting, so the sealed quantity is the band, not a forecast of individual items.

### (d) One KV head per model, stable across families

Prediction D1 (within model): one (layer, kv) cell is the causal argmax on ≥ 0.80 of correct two-hop items in every Qwen3 size, and that cell's share of the full V-band effect (median fraction of the band's margin move) is ≥ 0.40 (measured 1.7B 0.61; Qwen2.5-1.5B 0.46 as a flip fraction, a different statistic). Prediction D2 (index not stable): the KV index differs between Qwen3 sizes (KV6 at 1.7B is an index, not a role); what is stable is one dominant cell at the same row in a ≤ 3-layer window, with the runner-up in the same KV group one or two layers earlier (1.7B: L18 KV6 on 29/64; Qwen2.5-1.5B: L23 KV0 as runner-up breaks this, so D2's runner-up clause is sealed only for Qwen3). Prediction D3 (Qwen2.5 is a weak test): with 2 KV heads, "one KV head" is a coin, so for Qwen2.5 the sealed statement is about the two cells, L22 KV1 and L23 KV0 on 1.5B: on 0.5B and 3B the top two cells are in adjacent layers at the same row and together carry ≥ 0.70 of the band effect, and the layer of the top cell follows (a). Prediction D4 (family-stable): the same cell is the causal argmax on currency, person, landmark and city families at ≥ 0.75 each (measured 1.7B: 64/64 pooled). Also check the GQA mapping per model before anything else: Qwen3 maps query heads h → kv h // (H/KV), 4 Q per KV at 4B against 2 at 1.7B, so "L20 h12+h13" becomes a 4-head group at 4B.

### (e) Harder prompts: cell error or downstream error

The hardness types attack different stages, so the error locus differs by type (derived from the stage model; the numbers are asserted bars). Measured Y2 on 1.7B: hard correct items keep the country at the declared carrier on 108/114, and on wrong items the carrier names the true bridge on only 17/116, so most hard errors on 1.7B are already at or before the cell. Sealed per type, over wrong items only:

- Obscure entities (obsc): the cell is wrong. Carrier names a wrong country or ranks the true one > 3 on ≥ 0.70 of wrong items (recall failure upstream).
- Distractor naming another country (dist): the cell is right, the routing is wrong. The true descriptor's carrier still names the true country on ≥ 0.60 of wrong items, while the distractor row's own cell at the same (layer, kv) names the distractor country on ≥ 0.60, and the reader's mass on the distractor cell exceeds its mass on the true cell on ≥ 0.60 of those errors. The table should show two carriers competing, and the answer follows the larger mass × content margin (P05 share). Falsifier for this sub-claim: the true carrier is wrong on ≥ 0.50 of distractor errors, which means the distractor corrupted the content, not the read.
- Long context (long): routing again. Content at the true carrier unchanged on ≥ 0.70 of wrong items; the carrier's read mass (excluding t0, §4.4) is below the correct-item median on ≥ 0.70 of wrong items.
- Paraphrase (para): neither. The 1.7B para families answer " The" (format default, FT1), so the cell is right on ≥ 0.80 of wrong items and the error is at the consumer; chain readability is defined only when the model does not emit a format token, and that must be a preregistered exclusion.
- Language-answer (lang): cell right on ≥ 0.80 of correct items (108/114 class), errors split as dist/obsc above by the sub-type.

Across sizes: the obsc cell-error share falls with size (recall improves) and the dist routing-error share does not fall by more than 0.15 (routing is a property of the reader, asserted). Items with n < 8 wrong are reported only.
memo_section_3_verbatim:
## 3. Metrics and nulls, fixed per model

- Carrier rule: the causal argmax over span-row cells from Job A's single-cell sweep (|dM| in logits, noise floor 2 bf16 spacings at the larger |logit| of the pair). The passive proposal is the P05 share ranking p·c·W_O v from Job C; report hit@1 and hit@3 of the proposal against the causal argmax, which is what Run 1's forecast actually measured (174/178 top cell). Report row rules R_argmax, R_last, R_first side by side and credit the rule only where they differ (B1's 27/29 vs 13/29 was 23/29 one family; break it down).
- Readout: best-of-set rank of the truth at the carrier through `cell_readout` (γ_F ⊙ W_U over declared Candidates), country first. Every co-readout (capital, language, creator, city) is scored twice: raw, and with the item's country direction u_c = γ_F ⊙ W_U[country] projected out of the write. The lexical null (u_c alone as the write) is printed beside each co-readout, and a co-readout counts only where it beats the lexical null (AUDIT-B1 §6: capital 105/105 from u_c alone is an artefact; creator 10/24 where the null fails is the real positive). For Qwen2.5 the cell functional has an affine term: Qwen2.5's attention has q/k/v projection biases (asserted; verify in the port program), so `cell_readout`, which currently refuses a V bias, needs C_D(v) = c_D·h + dᵀ(Σ_h W_O,h) b_V^g; the constant drops out of differences but not of absolute ranks.
- Effect-size tests, not sign: Spearman(forecast or proposal, native |dM|) over cells above the floor, with the shuffled 95th percentile beside it (B1: 0.70 vs 0.13), and the ratio forecast/native with IQR (0.52×). Retire sign agreement for same-direction transplants (153/153 was trivial). Flip counts are reported but never a bar.
- Site nulls, all on the same items: fixed site (the model's modal cell at the last span row), mass (largest answer-row attention excluding t0), random span row (exact expectation over rows), shuffled cell (a (layer, kv) drawn from the model's own frozen distribution), cross-item cell (same address, another item of the family must not name this country; 1.7B 1/57–2/60), and lens at the answer row pre-read (L_c.h) and at L_c + 4.
- Concentration for (d): the top cell's margin move over the V-band move, median and IQR; plus top-two share for Qwen2.5.
- Per-family breakdowns always; no pooled number is a verdict. No constancy or mean statistic across items that share a prefix (TP1 lesson: 496/710 rows were copies). The two-hop panel's few-shot prefix is shared, so any position-mean or token-mean is built from the sentence prompts or self-excluded.
- Closure witness (ch 13, equal codes preserve futures): the same-country mean cell keeps the answer on ≥ 0.90 (1.7B 62/63) and another country's mean cell moves the argmax to that capital on ≥ 0.40 (1.7B 34/64). This is the per-model check that the cell's code is the country.
- Custody: prereg committed before Job C; the readout rules and candidate sets frozen before any capture is opened; passive forecasts sealed between C and A; the log prints ids and seconds only.
memo_section_5_verbatim:
## 5. Falsifiers

- (a) Fraction rule: both 36-layer carriers at or above L29 falsifies A1 (A2 stands); one at ≤ L28 and the other ≥ L29 falsifies both as laws and the carrier layer is model-specific. The within-model mode covering < 0.60 of correct items in any Qwen3 size falsifies "one carrier per model".
- (b) Hop budget: L_first flat across d2–d4 (differences < 1 layer at the median) falsifies B1, and the collapse is then recall, not budget. AUC < 0.6 of the slack falsifies B2. Back-patch repair ≤ 0.10 on late-country items falsifies B3. Any (model, family) cell with accuracy < 0.5 and readable-error share < 0.40 falsifies B4 for that cell; two such cells falsify it as a law. 4B improving d4 by ≥ 0.2 with L_first(d4) not moving earlier by ≥ 2 layers falsifies B5. Equal MLP-ablation drops for language and capital margins falsify "hop 3 is downstream".
- (c) Split: MLP share within ±0.05 of 0.55 at every size falsifies the tail dependence; a share that moves by > 0.15 between doses 0.5 and 1.0 means the split is a threshold and the band is retired for that model.
- (d) One cell: the top cell's share of the band effect < 0.25 in a Qwen3 size falsifies "one dominant cell"; the same KV index at 0.6B, 1.7B and 4B would be a surprise that falsifies D2 and is worth a post on its own; a family-level carrier agreement < 0.60 on any family falsifies D4.
- (e) Error locus: distractor errors with the true carrier wrong on ≥ 0.50 falsify the routing reading for dist; obscure errors with the carrier right on ≥ 0.50 falsify the content reading for obsc; paraphrase errors that are not format tokens on ≥ 0.50 of items mean the para exclusion was wrong and the family is judged like dist.
- Whole programme: if, on Qwen3-4B, the causal argmax cell at the carrier names the country on < 0.70 of correct two-hop items, the symbol map does not transfer as a readout across sizes and the grid stops after 4B and Qwen2.5-1.5B; the write-up is then the two-model comparison.

operational.item_carrier: argmax over swept cells of -dM (the cell whose donor value most lowers M); reported only when |dM| > floor
operational.model_carrier: modal (layer, kv) of item carriers over correct base two-hop items (48 base items; correct = argmax == answer); row stays item-specific (the item carrier's row)
operational.carrier_at_item: for content statements on any item (correct or wrong): the model carrier (layer, kv) at row r* = argmax over span rows of -dM at that (layer, kv)
operational.rule_A1_A2: judged on the Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen2.5-3B model carriers' layers, as memo §1(a)
operational.mode_coverage: share of correct base items whose item carrier equals the model carrier (layer, kv)
operational.write_window: at the item carrier row: layers with any kv cell |dM| > floor; span = max - min + 1; share of correct base items with span <= 5
operational.accuracy_bands: memo §1(b) table; d3 pools d3-lm and d3-per; a model's band is hit if the accuracy lies inside
operational.L_first: as prereg_hopbudget.json with L_c = the model carrier layer and the carrier row = carrier_at_item row; chance guard as there; L_first_stable reported beside
operational.B3_backpatch: wrong d3/d4 items: Run.set t<r>.L<L_c-4>.h := native t<r>.L<L_c+4>.h at r = carrier_at_item row (stepped run, prefill=span[0]); repaired = answer argmax becomes the answer; split late (L_first present) vs never (absent by L_c)
operational.B4: readable error = the model carrier at carrier_at_item names a wrong country or ranks the true one > 3 of the 57 countries
operational.B6_mlp_ablation: answer row m at layers L_c..L_c+2 replaced by the mean of the same port over the other panel items of the same block (self-excluded); margin = logit(answer) - max logit over the rest of its candidate set (languages for depth, cities for base); drop = native - ablated; prediction: median language drop >= 2 x median capital drop
operational.readout: gamma_F * W_U over the candidate set on the cell write W_g v, v the cached value (for Qwen2.5 the cache already holds W_V x + b_V, so no extra term); the residual-port functional cell_readout is affine on Qwen2.5 (c . h + d . W_g b_V, commit 68080ff, tested) and the constant cancels in every hop_edge difference
operational.co_readouts: capital (cities) and language at the carrier: raw; with u_c = gamma_F * W_U[country] projected out of the write AND out of every candidate direction (ch 23 rank-one whitening); lexical null = u_c alone as the write; a co-readout counts only on items where the projected readout names the truth AND the lexical null does not
operational.projected_language_chance: the item's country replaced by another item's country (derangement, random.Random(0)) before projecting; the projected-language hit count is reported beside its shuffled count
operational.proposal: passive P05 score per span cell from Job C: sum over the group's query heads h of p_h(r) * d . W_O,h (v_donor - v) at the answer row, d = gamma_F * (W_U[a] - W_U[b]); hit@1 / hit@3 against the item carrier
operational.row_rules: R_argmax (reader heads = the model carrier group's query heads at L_c), R_last, R_first, S(r) = sum_h p_h(r) * country margin of the carrier cell at r (memo §4.1); each credited only on items where the rules differ; per family
operational.effect_size: Spearman(forecast, native dM) over swept cells with |dM| > floor, per item then median, beside the 95th percentile of the same statistic with the forecast shuffled across cells (200 shuffles, Random(0)); ratio forecast/native median and IQR
site_nulls: fixed site: the model carrier (layer, kv) at the last span row
mass: the span-or-prefix row with the largest non-sink answer-row attention mass at L_c (t0 excluded, renormalised), model carrier kv

cross-item: the same (row index from span end, layer, kv) in another item of the family with another country must not name this item's country
lens: answer row h at L_c and at L_c + 4 through the final norm and W_U over countries
